In May 2024, **Dr. Amit Kumar Srivastava** joined the Leibniz Centre for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF) as a Tenure-Track Senior Scientist. He previously worked for ten years as a Senior Scientist at the Institute of Crop Science and Resource Conservation, University of Bonn, and as a Scientific Project Officer at the European Commission's Joint Research Centre.
